debt.title: Debt process
debt.subtitle: Timed chase after a delinquency case opens. Fees and overlock stay in Late fees & delinquency.
debt.exitStatement: Enrolment ends automatically when the balance is paid, written off, or the contract ends.
debt.howItWorks: While a case is open, the sequence waits between steps. The moment the case is cured — payment, write-off, or vacate — the enrolment exits, including mid-wait. One active debt playbook per site coverage. WhatsApp template steps do not open a customer-service window — only the tenant's inbound reply does — so free-form follow-up continues in the inbox after they respond, not inside the enrolment.

lead.exitStatement: Enrolment ends automatically when the deal advances, is won, or is lost.
lead.howItWorks: A new deal matching your filters enrols once. Stage advance outside the configured set, win, or loss exits the enrolment — including during a wait. Quiet-deal (untouched for N days) remains a recipe in the general automations editor.
